source.title: SciFi Vehicle Set 1 - Cars - 6mm (ORV 1.04)
source.author: Shiaic3D
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 7, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. RIGHTS: Shiaic3D, SciFi Vehicle Set 1 (Printables 108620, the ORV 1.04 file), labelled CC BY 4.0; part of a set that includes remixes of untraced originals; rights unverified; Lee accepted the risk on 2026-10-31. The fit is level (`no_icp`; v1 had no joints). WHEELED, 2 axles, 4 OWN GEOMETRY wheels (`make_wheel`) on axles fitted to the kit's wheel arches (kit wheel faces cut from the hull; part of the derivative), the front pair under `steer_*`. No turret or gun. No brand marks found on the mesh. Welded at 3 mm, planar-dissolved at 1.5 degrees.
